resolved_from_round_1.detail: RESOLVED: all four useCallback wrappers (handleCenterChange, handleSelectDestination, handleCancel, handleOrdered) removed and inlined as plain const arrow functions; the useCallback import is dropped (L1 imports only useEffect, useState). No React.memo added to children. Behavior unchanged; 8 MapOrderPage tests stay green.

RESOLVED: the bare-/customer test now asserts winner.children === undefined (L32-33) in addition to the retained length === 1 check. This structurally discriminates the childless MapOrderPage leaf from the CustomerLayout branch (which carries a children array) -- a future regression of CustomerLayout winning would make winner.children a defined array and fail the assertion. The test now verifies what its name claims.
